finite-certificates.meaning: Exact finite propositions and execution manifests; no asymptotic promotion.

reference.meaning: Pinned immutable reference inputs/curves used by maintained regressions.

executions.meaning: Dated workspace/run/build provenance. Historical paths are not moved because they are themselves recorded provenance.

dated-research-packets.meaning: Dated packets may mix exact finite checks, floating diagnostics, and execution records. Each object's own scope and accompanying review control its interpretation; the directory name is not an evidence grade.

trust_rule: Evidence establishes only the proposition explicitly recorded by its producer/review.
